notes.title: June 25 Update Announcement(Version No. V1.0_0625_Release)
notes.notes:
BUG:
1. Repair the problem of not being able to play cards after canceling the pause
2. Repair the problem of incorrect display of upgrade experience

notes.title: [Official Version] June 23 Update Announcement
[Official Version] June 20 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
BUG.
1. Fixed the problem that mortar attacks could not be recovered after being interrupted;

Modifications:
1. Pull in Stone Thrower effect modification.
Original effect: Stone Thrower consumes 1 Ammo per attack and replenishes 1(2) Ammo when discarded.
New effect: Stone Thrower consumes 1 Ammo per attack, replenishes 2(3) Ammo when discarded, and the weapon's Attack Power is equal to its current Ammo count.

Translated with DeepL.com (free version)

notes.title: Update on 2024.2.25
notes.notes:
1.Optimized English text.
2.There is a chance for orange cards to appear in the shop.

Bug Fixes:
1. Military Power Core +: Inconsistency between description and effect.
2. All-Out Attack +: Inconsistency between description and effect.

notes.title: Update on 2024.2.22
notes.notes:
System:
1. Added new player tutorial.

Bug Fixes:
1. Fixed an issue causing the game to crash when recruiting sailor agents with insufficient card quantity.
2. Optimized enemy attacks ignoring guards and targeting other positions.

notes.title: 2024.2.21 Update
notes.notes:
Cards:
1. Empty City: Now stops all weapons from attacking on the field for 15 seconds. Afterward, deals 20 (30) damage to all enemies on the field.
2. CleanUp: Now gains 5 (7) supply for every card in the draw pile.
3. Advance: Cost reduced from 20 to 15.

Optimizations:
1. When hovering over a weapon with the mouse, it now accurately displays the weapon's current attack power and maximum health.
2. Added more selectable game resolutions.
3. Card packs from level completion rewards will no longer contain duplicate cards.
4. There is now a chance for orange or blue cards to appear in card packs from level completion rewards.

Bug Fixes:
1. Fixed the bug where enemies would sometimes ram the deck twice.
2. Fixed the bug where the game resolution was incorrect on some laptops.
3. Fixed the issue with the incorrect effect of the Sound Mixer +.
4. Fixed the discrepancy between the effect and description of the Yin and Yang Harmony card.

notes.title: Update on February 19
notes.notes:
Cards:
1. The cost of "Sowing Beans into Soldiers" has been adjusted from 80 to 90.
2. Fixed the issue where upgrading the Butcher Chainsaw Cannon had no effect.

Optimizations:
1. When players choose to return to the city without claiming a reward, they will be prompted again that there are unredeemed rewards.

Bug Fixes:
1. Fixed a bug where players could not click on buildings when the Candle Dragon Boss used "Polar Night's Descent."
